title: Unstick Decision Log Entry
description: Privacy-safe decision trace for the local task-start engine. Lives ONLY on-device (in-memory ring buffer, capped at 64 entries). Raw task text is replaced by a non-reversible FNV-1a hash. Nothing here is ever transmitted anywhere by default.

decisionId.description: Locally generated UUID. Never leaves the device.

sessionId.description: Local session reference (may be empty pre-session).

policyVersion.description: Ranking policy that produced this decision (e.g. heuristic-v1).

taskHash.description: FNV-1a hash of the normalized task title. Raw text is intentionally NOT stored.

analysis.description: Reduced analysis snapshot — numeric signals only, no free text.

candidates.description: Scored candidate set (top 10). Action text retained in-memory only for the buffer's lifetime.

selectionProbability.description: The engine is deterministic: the top valid candidate is always selected. Never faked.

shownAt.description: ms epoch when the action was presented.

startedAt.description: ms epoch when the user began, if known.

validationFailures.description: Count of candidates rejected by the validator in this decision.

reward.description: Evaluation baseline (§29) — components kept separate; never used for online updates while adaptive policy is disabled.

privacy.retention: in-memory ring buffer, 64 entries, cleared on reload
privacy.transmission: none by default; remote AI endpoint only if explicitly configured by the user
